mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ccds_station_snapshot (station_id, in_count, warn_count, danger_count, out_count, pending_count, group_count, last_event_at, payload_json, gmt_create, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{stationId}, #{inCount}, #{warnCount}, #{dangerCount}, #{outCount}, #{pendingCount}, #{groupCount}, #{lastEventAt}, #{payloadJson}, #{gmtCreate}, #{gmtModified})
mapper.update: UPDATE ccds_station_snapshot SET in_count = #{inCount}, warn_count = #{warnCount}, danger_count = #{dangerCount}, out_count = #{outCount}, pending_count = #{pendingCount}, group_count = #{groupCount}, last_event_at = #{lastEventAt}, payload_json = #{payloadJson}, gmt_modified = #{gmtModified} WHERE station_id = #{stationId}
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM ccds_station_snapshot WHERE (in_count + warn_count + danger_count) > 0 ORDER BY last_event_at DESC, station_id ASC

FROM ccds_station_snapshot WHERE gmt_modified > #{since} ORDER BY gmt_modified ASC, station_id ASC
